rationale: The agent did perform user lookup and retrieved user details, but then executed order-changing writes (exchange_delivered_order_items and return_delivered_order_items) without any visible user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm before taking action. For the skateboard request, the user asked to see all shorter bamboo options with prices and to choose the most expensive; the interaction shows only a single get_product_details call and no presentation of options or prices before proceeding, so the requirement was not met. For the garden hose, the user wanted an exchange to the same type as a pending order; instead, the agent appears to have processed a return, not an exchange to match the pending item, and again without confirmation. The final message provides no confirmation details or summaries. Given these issues, the request was not completed in line with policy.
